summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories (hubs where models are hosted, shared, and downloaded) and developer-facing inference platforms (APIs that serve open-weight models at scale). Hugging Face anchors the ecosystem as the central hub, crossing 3 million public models in August 2026, though download distribution is highly concentrated—roughly half of all models have fewer than 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly 50% of downloads. Platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow complement the hubs by making it easy to run or serve these open models locally or via managed APIs.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: Central open repository and community hub for hosting, sharing, and discovering models, datasets, and Spaces demos, plus a serverless and dedicated inference offering.
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public repos and limited inference; Pro at ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and dedicated compute billed by instance/hour; Enterprise plans available.
features: Largest open model and dataset registry
Spaces for hosting demos and apps
Inference Endpoints and serverless Inference API
Model cards, versioning, and download statistics
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and open-source developers needing the broadest selection of models and datasets plus flexible hosting and inference.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local-first runtime for downloading and running open LLMs on personal machines and servers with a simple CLI and REST API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models and quantized variants in its library (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral, DeepSeek)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source for local use; no usage fees since inference runs on your own hardware.
features: Optimized GGUF/quantized models for consumer hardware
Built-in REST API compatible with OpenAI format
Modelfile customization and local fine-tune hosting
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists who want to run open models locally for privacy, prototyping, or offline use.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform to run and share open models via API, with easy deployment of custom models using Cog containers.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models across text, image, audio, and video
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing); no subscription required.
features: Run models via a single API call
Cog packaging for deploying custom models
Web playground and shareable model pages
platforms.best_for: App developers who want quick API access to a wide variety of open models without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-weight LLMs with an OpenAI-compatible API.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (priced per million tokens by model size); dedicated GPU endpoints and fine-tuning billed separately.
features: Broad open-model catalog including image models
Batch inference and function calling support
platforms.best_for: Teams building production applications on open models who need scalable, cost-efficient inference and fine-tuning.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Speed-optimized inference platform for open LLMs and multimodal models with enterprise-grade latency and throughput.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open and fine-tuned models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, vision models)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand and reserved dedicated GPU deployments; fine-tuning billed by usage.
features: FireAttention optimized inference engine for low latency
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises prioritizing fast, low-latency, high-throughput inference on open models.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: Developer inference platform serving a large catalog of open-source LLMs and multimodal models, popular in Asia-Pacific markets.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, GLM, FLUX, and audio/image models)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token usage pricing with competitive rates; free credits for new users; dedicated deployment options.
features: Strong support for Chinese and multilingual open models
Text, image, audio, and video model endpoints
platforms.best_for: Developers seeking affordable inference and strong coverage of Chinese/multilingual open models, especially in APAC.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: Ultra-low-latency inference platform running open LLMs on custom LPU hardware for real-time applications.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mixtral, Whisper)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; enterprise and on-prem options available.
features: LPU hardware delivering extremely high token throughput
Low-latency streaming for agents and chat
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive, real-time AI experiences on open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified API gateway/aggregator that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pass-through per-token pricing plus a small markup; pay-as-you-go credits.
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Price and latency comparison across providers
Access to both open-weight and proprietary models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to a wide range of open and closed models through one API.
